'''Purring maggots''' are a type of [[cavern]]-living [[vermin]] notable for being the only underground source of [[milk]], known as [[dwarven milk]]. They can be obtained by [[Trapper|trapping]] them with [[animal trap]]s. They are [[hateable]] vermin and will inspire an unhappy [[thought]] in [[dwarves]] that detest them.

To obtain these maggots you will need to discover the 2nd or 3rd cavern layer, then construct ({{k-|b|m}}) [[animal trap]]s on cave moss there. Use {{k|q}} to set meat/fish for bait. A higher quality trap will increase the chances of catching a purring maggot instead of losing the bait.

Some dwarves [[Preference|like]] purring maggots for their ''comforting whirs''.

[[File:purring_maggots.png|thumb|302px|center|Sound cuter than they look.<br><small>''Art by Zippy''</small>]]

==Bugs==
* Tamed purring maggots can't be milked. {{Bug|3670}}
* After being milked, purring maggots are left inside the workshop as an item unless they are assigned to a [[cage]]. {{Bug|3668}}
